body.condition: For all distinct \(i,j\in V\) and all \(a,b\in M\), \(\operatorname{Cov}_P(\varepsilon_i^{(a)},\varepsilon_j^{(b)})=0\).

novel.justification: This component-alignment restriction says that cross-view dependence is carried only by disturbances with the same variable label. Under joint Gaussianity it is equivalent to mutual independence of the stacked vectors \((\varepsilon_i^{(a)})_{a\in M}\) across distinct \(i\), and, for any candidate order, it is exactly the structural restriction represented by diagonal residual cross-blocks. The concrete mechanism \(\varepsilon_i^{(a)}=\lambda_{ia}U_i+\eta_i^{(a)}\) in \(\text{def:coordinate-sensor-mechanism}\) realizes it for coordinate-aligned repeated sensors with coordinate-specific shared shocks and independent readout noise; it is not asserted for arbitrary multimodal or neuroimaging measurements.
